parameters.description_en: The input table. It can be a text file, CSV file, Excel file, dBASE table, or geodatabase table.
The output feature class containing geodetic or planar lines.

A numerical field in the input table containing the x-coordinates (or longitudes) of the starting points of lines to be positioned in the output coordinate system specified by the Spatial Reference parameter.

A numerical field in the input table containing the y-coordinates (or latitudes) of the starting points of lines to be positioned in the output coordinate system specified by the Spatial Reference parameter.

A numerical field in the input table containing the x-coordinates (or longitudes) of the ending points of lines to be positioned in the output coordinate system specified by the Spatial Reference parameter.

A numerical field in the input table containing the y-coordinates (or latitudes) of the ending points of lines to be positioned in the output coordinate system specified by the Spatial Reference parameter.

Specifies the type of line that will be constructed. Geodesic—A type of geodetic line that most accurately represents the shortest distance between any two points on the surface of the earth will be constructed. This is the default. Great circle—A type of geodetic line that represents the path between any two points along the intersection of the surface of the earth and a plane that passes through the center of the earth will be constructed. If the Spatial Reference parameter value is a spheroid-based coordinate system, the line is a great elliptic. If the Spatial Reference parameter value is a sphere-based coordinate system, the line is uniquely called a great circle—a circle of the largest radius on the spherical surface. Rhumb line—A type of geodetic line, also known as a loxodrome line, that represents a path between any two points on the surface of a spheroid defined by a constant azimuth from a pole will be constructed. A rhumb line is shown as a straight line in the Mercator projection. Normal section—A type of geodetic line that represents a path between any two points on the surface of a spheroid defined by the intersection of the spheroid surface and a plane that passes through the two points and is normal (perpendicular) to the spheroid surface at the starting point of the two points will be constructed. The normal section line from point A to point B is different from the line from point B to point A. Planar line—A straight line in the projected plane will be used. A planar line usually does not accurately represent the shortest distance on the surface of the earth as a geodesic line does. This option is not available for geographic coordinate systems.
A field in the input table. This field and the values are included in the output and can be used to join the output features with the records in the input table.
The spatial reference of the output feature class. The default is GCS_WGS_1984 or the input coordinate system if it is not Unknown.

Specifies whether the remaining input fields will be added to the output feature class. Checked—The remaining input fields will be added to the output feature class. A new field, ORIG_FID, will also be added to the output feature class to store the input feature ID values. Unchecked—The remaining input fields will not be added to the output feature class. This is the default.

text: 可從 LAS 資料集、點云場景圖層包或 I3S 點云圖層中的分類鐵路軌道中提取鐵路軌道線和中心線。

topic: 從點云中提取軌道 (3D Analyst 工具)
text:
此工具需要安裝深度學習框架。 要設置計算機以在 ArcGIS Pro 中使用深度學習框架，請參閱 安裝 ArcGIS 的深度學習框架。
此工具需要對軌道點進行分類。 鐵路圖徵由分類的鐵路點組成。 LAS 標準采用類 10 鐵路，但也可以指定自定義類。 如果提供了多個類，則每個類將被視為代表不同類型的鐵路，并將分別處理以產生不同的輸出圖徵。 雖然鐵路提取過程可以克服噪音，但減少鐵路點分類的錯誤將會帶來更準確的鐵路圖徵。
輸出鐵路線和中心線將有 CLASS_CODE 欄位，用于指示用于生成圖徵的點類。
鐵路交叉口的存在，即道岔將鐵路連接或分割成不同的軌道，通常會導致輸出路軌和中心線的不連續性。
雖然可以使用 CPU 運行該工具，但建議您使用支持 CUDA 的 NVIDIA GPU 執行此操作。 如果存在多個支持 CUDA 的 GPU，請指定 GPU ID 環境值 -1 以使用所有符合條件的 GPU。

依工具窗格順序核對下列參數；展開同頁的參數卡可查說明、選項與資料型別。輸入點云 [in_point_cloud]、軌道類代碼 [class_codes]、輸出軌道線 [out_3d_lines]、軌道標準 （可選） [rail_standard]、輸出 3D 中心線 （可選） [out_3d_centerlines]、軌距 （可選） [track_gauge]、軌道厚度 （可選） [rail_thickness]、水平平滑核距離 （可選） [horizontal_smoothing_kernel_distance]、垂直平滑核距離 （可選） [vertical_smoothing_kernel_distance]、水平軌道容差 （可選） [horizontal_rail_tolerance]、垂直軌道容差 （可選） [vertical_rail_tolerance]、中心線對齊容差 （可選） [centerline_alignment_tolerance]、軌道拱度檢測半徑 （可選） [rail_crown_detection_radius]、水平簡化容差 （可選） [horizontal_simplification_tolerance]、垂直簡化容差 （可選） [vertical_simplification_tolerance]、最小輸出線長度 （可選） [min_line_length]
依用法、環境與授權段落核對限制。確認輸出位置或就地修改範圍後執行 Run。
在 Geoprocessing History 檢查執行狀態與訊息，再核對結果是否符合使用者指定的範圍與條件。

section: 英文版工具簽章與參數順序

parameters.description_en: The input LAS dataset or point cloud scene layer containing the classified railway points.
The class codes that will be used for rail points.
The output 3D rail lines that will be extracted from the point cloud.

Specifies the rail standard that will be used. The standard describes the measurements of the track gauge and rail thickness. The specification will impact the algorithm that will be used for extracting the rail features. US Standard 115RE—The 115 lb United States rail standard defined by the American Railway Engineering and Maintenance-of-Way Association (AREMA) will be used. This is the default. US Standard 132RE—The 132 lb United States rail standard defined by AREMA will be used. US Standard 141RE—The 141 lb United States rail standard defined by AREMA will be used. EU Standard UIC54—The 54.77 kg European rail standard defined by the International Union of Railways will be used. EU Standard UIC60—The 60 kg European rail standard defined by the International Union of Railways will be used. Custom—A different standard will be used. When this option is specified, provide values for the track gauge and rail thickness parameters.
The output 3D center line that represents the middle of the rail track.

The track gauge that describes the inner distance between the two rails of a railway track. The default is 1435 millimeters, which corresponds to the US 115 RE standard, but this value will be updated to match the specified rail standard.
The width of the top part of each rail. The default value is 66.675 millimeters, which corresponds to the US 115 RE standard, but this value will be updated to match the specified rail standard.

The x,y distance that will be used to apply a weighted average-based smoothing function in the horizontal direction onto the output rail lines. This parameter will help to overcome the distortions of incomplete, misclassified, or noisy rail points. The default is 0.8 meters.

The z-distance that will be used to apply a weighted average-based smoothing function in the vertical direction onto the output rail lines. This parameter will help to overcome the distortions of incomplete, misclassified, or noisy rail points. The default is 10 meters.
The distance that will be used in the x,y direction to identify points that belong to the same rail in a given track. The default is 10 centimeters.
The distance that will be used in the z-direction to identify points that belong to the same rail in a given track. The default is 3 centimeters.
The tolerance distance that will be used to align the centerline feature between the rails of a given track. The default is 50 millimeters.

parameters.label_zh: 軌道拱度檢測半徑 （可選）
parameters.description_en: The search radius that will be used to identify continuous points that define the rail crown, which is the topmost portion of a given rail track. The default is 20 meters.

The distance that will be used to simplify the output rail line in the x,y direction. The horizontal position of the simplified rail will not deviate from the original by more than this amount. The default is 2 millimeters.

The distance that will be used to simplify the output rail line in the z-direction. The height of the simplified rail will not deviate from the original by more than this amount. The default is 2 millimeters.

The minimum three-dimensional length that a detected line must have to be included in the output line features. Any detected line that is shorter than this length will be ignored. The default is 1 meter.

text: 依英文版參數表順序列出：in_point_cloud、class_codes、out_3d_lines、rail_standard、out_3d_centerlines、track_gauge、rail_thickness、horizontal_smoothing_kernel_distance、vertical_smoothing_kernel_distance、horizontal_rail_tolerance、vertical_rail_tolerance、centerline_alignment_tolerance、rail_crown_detection_radius、horizontal_simplification_tolerance、vertical_simplification_tolerance、min_line_length。選填標示、資料型別與英文原說明見 parameters。

topic: Huff Model Calibration (Business Analyst Tools)
text:
The output exponents are based on attractiveness values of the existing facilities and their spatial relationship to customer points.
Customer point data is a required input.
The Huff Model Calibration output is stored in the Business Analyst container in the Catalog pane.
Exponent values are correlated to the market defined by the inputs. Although they can be applied to additional markets, they may be less reliable in those scenarios.
The Huff Model Calibration output can be applied to the Huff Model tool.

topic: Huff Model Calibration (Business Analyst Tools)
steps: 開啟 Analysis > Tools，以英文名稱搜尋 Huff Model Calibration，核對工具箱及工具摘要。

依工具窗格順序核對下列參數；展開同頁的參數卡可查說明、選項與資料型別。Input Facility Features [in_facility_features]、Facility ID Field [facility_id_field]、Input Customer Features [in_customer_features]、Associated Facility ID Field [link_field]、Input Sales Potential Features [in_sales_potential_features]、Sales Potential ID Field [sales_potential_id_field]、Output Calibration [out_calibration]、Attractiveness Variables [attractiveness_variables]、Customer Weight Field （可選） [customer_weight_field]、Distance Type （可選） [distance_type]、Distance Units （可選） [distance_units]、Travel Direction （可選） [travel_direction]、Time of Day （可選） [time_of_day]、Time Zone （可選） [time_zone]
依用法、環境與授權段落核對限制。確認輸出位置或就地修改範圍後執行 Run。
在 Geoprocessing History 檢查執行狀態與訊息，再核對結果是否符合使用者指定的範圍與條件。
provenance: 依官方參數表編排的操作清單

topic: Huff Model Calibration (Business Analyst Tools)

parameters.description_en: The input point feature class representing competitors or existing stores.
A unique ID field representing a store or facility location.
The input point feature class representing customer locations.
The field that will be used as an ID to assign individual customers to a facility or store.
The input polygon feature class used to determine the potential sales market.
A unique ID field representing the sales potential area.

The output calibration file that will contain the calibrated Huff model results, which is the exponent values for the attractiveness variables and distance. The output file extension will be *.huffmodel.
The fields that will be used to determine the attractiveness of each competitor. In many cases, the size of the store is used as a substitute for attractiveness.
A calculated weighted value field assigned to each customer.
The calculated distance based on the method of travel. Straight Line is the default value.
The distance-measuring units that will be used when calculating distance.

Specifies the direction of travel that will be used between stores and sales potential features. Toward Stores—The direction of travel will be from sales potential features to stores. This is the default. Away from Stores—The direction of travel will be from stores to sales potential features.
The time and date that will be used when calculating distance.

Specifies the time zone that will be used for the Time of Day parameter. Time Zone at Location—The time zone in which the territories are located will be used. This is the default. UTC—Coordinated universal time (UTC) will be used.

signatures: arcpy.ba.HuffModelCalibration(in_facility_features, facility_id_field, in_customer_features, link_field, in_sales_potential_features, sales_potential_id_field, out_calibration, attractiveness_variables, {customer_weight_field}, {distance_type}, {distance_units}, {travel_direction}, {time_of_day}, {time_zone})
text: 依英文版參數表順序列出：in_facility_features、facility_id_field、in_customer_features、link_field、in_sales_potential_features、sales_potential_id_field、out_calibration、attractiveness_variables、customer_weight_field、distance_type、distance_units、travel_direction、time_of_day、time_zone。選填標示、資料型別與英文原說明見 parameters。
